primaryText: (In quel periodo / In quel momento) Gianni leggeva il giornale.
translation: (During that period) Gianni used to read the newspaper. / (At that moment) Gianni was reading the newspaper.
comment: Temporal anchoring to a large or small reference time selects the habitual or the progressive reading.

primaryText: (In quel periodo / In quel momento) Gianni guidava un'auto sportiva.
translation: (During that period) Gianni used to drive a sports car. / (At that moment) Gianni was driving a sports car.
comment: Repeated as (22). On HAB the same sports car is driven throughout; the same-object effect is compatible with common knowledge.

primaryText: (In quel periodo / In quel momento) Gianni leggeva un libro di filosofia.
translation: #(During that period) Gianni used to read a philosophy book. / (At that moment) Gianni was reading a philosophy book.
comment: Repeated as (7) and (28). Odd on HAB: the same-object effect, reading the same book over and over, conflicts with common knowledge.

primaryText: (In quel periodo) Gianni fumava un sigaro toscano (il Toscanello).
translation: (During that period) Gianni used to smoke a kind of Tuscan cigar (the Toscanello).
comment: Repeated as (9a) and (25). The indefinite is coerced to a kind reading; on the individual reading the sentence would be odd on HAB (footnote 5).

primaryText: Gianni viaggia in treno.
translation: Gianni (generally) travels by train.
comment: The covert quantifier analysis maps (4a) and (4b) onto isomorphic logical forms (5a) and (5b).

primaryText: Gianni viaggia sempre in treno.
translation: Gianni always travels by train.

primaryText: Quando va a trovare i suoi parenti, Gianni viaggia sempre in treno.
translation: When he goes visit his relatives, Gianni always travels by train.
comment: The when-clause supplies the restriction of the Q-adverb, (6').

primaryText: (In quel periodo) Gianni leggeva sempre / spesso un libro di filosofia.
translation: (During that period) Gianni would always / often read a philosophy book.
context: A suitable discourse context which provides a restriction for the Q-adverb (footnote 9).
comment: Repeated as (29). The indefinite scopes below the Q-adverb, so the book varies with the situation and no same-object effect arises.

primaryText: Gianni non fumava nessun sigaro toscano (ma ora ha una passione per il Toscanello).
translation: Gianni used to smoke no kind of Tuscan cigar (but now he has a passion for the Toscanello).
comment: The negative indefinite must scope below negation; with obligatory wide scope over GEN its truth conditions, (10b), are too weak, and the intuitive reading is (10'b).

primaryText: (In quel periodo / In quel momento) Gianni leggeva libri di filosofia.
translation: (During that period) Gianni used to read philosophy books. / #(At that moment) Gianni was reading philosophy books.
comment: Repeated as (30). The bare plural names the kind and distributes its instances over the singular sub-events, so only a kind-level effect arises (footnote 33).

primaryText: Gianni leggeva un genere di libri di filosofia (libri di filosofia morale).
translation: Gianni used to read a kind of philosophy books (books of moral philosophy). / #Gianni was reading a kind of philosophy books (books of moral philosophy).
comment: A kind-level same-object effect over a sub-kind of the kind of philosophy books, which makes sense pragmatically.

primaryText: Gianni fumava sigari toscani.
translation: Gianni used to smoke Tuscan cigars.
context: Gianni had the habit of smoking Tuscan cigars without an inclination for any particular sub-kind (footnote 12).
comment: (9a) asymmetrically entails (13) on the habitual reading: in the footnote 12 scenario (13) is true and (9a) is not.

primaryText: Gianni leggeva un certo genere di libri (i.e. libri di filosofia).
translation: (During that period) Gianni used to read a certain kind of books (i.e. philosophy books).
comment: The kind-denoting indefinite that expresses the existential generalization of (11) (footnote 13).

primaryText: Gianni mangiava ciliegie.
translation: (At that moment) Gianni was eating cherries. / (During that period) Gianni used to eat cherries.
comment: A bare plural imperfective good on PROG: the average temporal size of the singular events decides the availability of the reading.

primaryText: Alle 15 Gianni era a casa, leggeva un libro.
translation: At 3pm Gianni was at home, he was reading a book.
comment: The same reference situation is forward-expanded twice, with a null expansion for the stative clause and a non-null one for the activity clause.

primaryText: Ogni giorno alle 15 Gianni prendeva il caffè.
translation: Every day at 3pm Gianni would take coffee.
comment: The quantificational adverbial is part of the description of the habit and does not anchor it; the habit still needs a reference time adverbial, (20). The paper prints caffé.

primaryText: In quel periodo, ogni giorno alle 15 Gianni prendeva il caffè.
translation: During that period, every day at 3pm Gianni would take coffee.
comment: Only the initial adverbial anchors the habit; the quantificational adverbial contributes a universal quantification within it. The paper prints caffé.

primaryText: Alle 15 Gianni guidava auto sportive.
translation: ? At 3pm Gianni was driving sports cars.
comment: A small reference situation clashes with the plurality of the verb phrase; the clash motivates instantiating the event quantifier by a singular event for PROG.

primaryText: Quando voleva meditare, Gianni leggeva sempre un libro di filosofia.
translation: When he wanted to meditate, Gianni would always read a philosophy book.
comment: The when-clause realizes the restriction of sempre that (29) accommodates; both Imperfetto forms manifest one IMPF feature (assumption C).

primaryText: (In quel periodo) Gianni giocava a tennis.
translation: (During that period) Gianni used to play tennis.
comment: The lexical cumulativity hypothesis at work: there is a plural event of Gianni playing tennis whose temporal trace includes the relevant period.

primaryText: Gianni ha fumato Toscanelli per vent'anni.
translation: Gianni smoked Toscanelli for twenty years.
comment: The frequentative motivating Distribution to Sub-Events, (21): a series of smoking events lasted twenty years and each had a cigar of the kind Toscanello as its theme.
